leah: Heads-up: I reproduced a weird repeat when onboarding magnet-13b-int4 with a long streaming prefill + in-flight prefix insert. Duplicate token appears right after a KV refill around token ~2048. Attaching minimal repro steps below.

mira: Can you paste the exact command and seed you ran?

leah: Ran this locally:
```
PYTHONPATH=. python experiments/repro_long_prefill.py \\
  --model magnet-13b --quant int4 --prompt data/long_prefill.txt \\
  --seed 2025 --max-tokens 4096 --stream-prefill --insert-prefix meta.json
```

devon: Quick log excerpt showing the glitch:
```
[DEBUG] gen: idx=2046 tok="which"
[DEBUG] gen: idx=2047 tok="played"
[DEBUG] refill: kv_end=2047
[DEBUG] gen: idx=2048 tok="played"  <-- repeated
```

sam: I retried the same flow on fp16 and int8 builds — repeat only on int4 so far. Could be quant kernel numerical drift or a rounding quirk in the int4 RoPE implementation.

mira: Interesting. Is this happening on single-GPU only or on sharded Dedicated too?

leah: Observed on both. On the sharded Dedicated run it crops up slightly earlier (around 1800-1900 tokens) which suggests interaction with per-shard position offsets.

devon: I added a KV hash checkpoint in the prefill->refill boundary: `kv_digest = hashlib.sha1(kv_block.cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest()`
Before refill: `f9c3a7e1` After refill: `3a7e1f9c` for same logical positions. Shows the cached keys differ after refill.

mira: Hypothesis: rotary phase multiplier computed from absolute token positions gets quantized/truncated differently between the prefill path and the live generation path in int4 kernels, causing a phase mismatch for keys persisted in the KV cache.

sam: I tried a tiny manual scale offset `--rope-bump=1.0005` and the duplication disappeared in my int4 runs. Not a fix but it points to brittle numeric sensitivity.

leah: Repro inputs attached to the bug. Also note it only happens when we do prefix insertion after the prefill warmed the cache. If we skip the insert step it doesn't reproduce.

devon: Action items I propose:
1) Add unit/regression test for "prefill -> insert prefix -> refill" across quant modes (int4/int8/fp16).
2) Bisect int4 kernel rounding path for rotary multiplies.
3) Add KV checksum to nightly long-context tests.

mira: For immediate onboarding risk mitigation, recommend disabling int4 for customers using >2k token contexts and default to int8. I'll open a rollout freeze ticket for int4 long-context variants.

ci-bot: CI job queued: `rope-int4-kv-checks` (branch rope-offset-fix) — https://ci.internal/rope/5678

sam: I'll open a PR with the test harness: experiments/tests/test_rope_refill_transition.py that simulates the exact sequence and compares token outputs between quant and fp16.

devon: Also check sharded position offsets: whether we normalize absolute positions per-shard before rotary scaling. That could explain why Dedicated hits earlier.

leah: Filed BUG-3510: "magnet-13b int4: KV cache key mismatch after refill when prefix insertion used" assigning @mira and @devon. Attaching logs and repro artifacts.

mira: Thanks. Will triage tomorrow morning. cc @eng-ml :eyes_icon:
